description: Victorian Farm Dam Boundaries is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bioregional Assessment Program. Abstract This dataset and its metadata statement were supplied to the Bioregional Assessment Programme by a third party. The dataset title and abstract are presented here as originally supplied. This dataset contains the digitised boundaries of farm dams in Victoria using a combination of satellite and aerial imagery. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bioregional Assessment Program. Its tags are Gippsland Basin bioregion, Victoria, inlandWaters. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2022-04-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
